tasks.description: Upgrade Java from 17 to a supported Azure-ready LTS version
tasks.requirements: Upgrade the project from Java 17 to the recommended Azure-supported LTS version (target Java 21 unless the platform standard requires a different LTS). Validate compatibility with the Spring Boot application, Maven build, and deployment target.

tasks.description: Move the application database from local PostgreSQL to Azure Database for PostgreSQL Flexible Server
tasks.requirements: Replace localhost JDBC configuration with environment-managed Azure PostgreSQL settings and secure connection properties. Update configuration files for development and production to use Azure-hosted managed database services instead of local database access.

tasks.description: Replace hard-coded credentials in application configuration with secure secret management
tasks.requirements: Remove datasource username and password values from application.properties and application-dev.properties. Replace them with environment variables or Azure Key Vault-backed secret resolution so the app no longer stores plaintext credentials in source-controlled files.

tasks.description: Remove local JDBC resource dependency and align the app to cloud-ready configuration
tasks.requirements: Eliminate localhost database access patterns from runtime configuration and reconfigure the application to use managed resources in Azure. Review spring.datasource.url, username, and password settings and update deployment environment configuration accordingly.

tasks.description: Add a Dockerfile and containerization support for Azure deployment
tasks.requirements: Create a Dockerfile for the Spring Boot application so it can deploy to Azure Container Apps or AKS. Ensure the image is buildable without relying on localhost-only configuration and includes the required runtime configuration for Azure-ready execution.

tasks.description: Scan and resolve CWE-259: Use of Hard-coded Password
tasks.requirements: Audit the application for hard-coded passwords and secrets. Remove embedded passwords from source-controlled configuration, add a secret-management remedy, and validate with a fresh secret scan to confirm the risk is resolved.

tasks.description: Scan and resolve CWE-778: Insufficient Logging
tasks.requirements: Add security-relevant logging for successful and failed authentication attempts in the student and instructor login flows. Ensure events capture enough context for security auditing without exposing plaintext secrets.

tasks.description: Scan and resolve CWE-798: Use of Hard-coded Credentials
tasks.requirements: Audit the codebase and configuration files for hard-coded usernames, passwords, and credentials. Remove exposed credentials from application.properties and application-dev.properties and protect credentials by injecting them from a managed secret source.
